import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))

# Create a 2x2 grid of scatter plots showing relationships between all features
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Scatter plot 1: Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
scatter1 = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['sepal_length'], df['sepal_width'], 
                              c=pd.Categorical(df['species']).codes, 
                              cmap='viridis', alpha=0.8, s=60)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sepal Length vs Sepal Width', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Scatter plot 2: Petal Length vs Petal Width
axes[0, 1].scatter(df['petal_length'], df['petal_width'], 
                   c=pd.Categorical(df['species']).codes, 
                   cmap='viridis', alpha=0.8, s=60)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Petal Length vs Petal Width', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Scatter plot 3: Sepal Length vs Petal Length
axes[1, 0].scatter(df['sepal_length'], df['petal_length'], 
                   c=pd.Categorical(df['species']).codes, 
                   cmap='viridis', alpha=0.8, s=60)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Sepal Length vs Petal Length', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Scatter plot 4: Sepal Width vs Petal Width
scatter4 = axes[1, 1].scatter(df['sepal_width'], df['petal_width'], 
                              c=pd.Categorical(df['species']).codes, 
                              cmap='viridis', alpha=0.8, s=60)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Sepal Width vs Petal Width', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Create a custom legend for species
species_names = df['species'].unique()
colors = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0, 1, len(species_names)))
legend_elements = [plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', 
                             markerfacecolor=colors[i], markersize=10, 
                             label=species_names[i]) 
                  for i in range(len(species_names))]
fig.legend(handles=legend_elements, title='Species', 
           loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.02), 
           ncol=3, fontsize=11, title_fontsize=12)

plt.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Feature Relationships by Species', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.05, 1, 0.96])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
